rows.title: AWS DataSync adds support for using tags in task executions
rows.summary: AWS DataSync now supports the use of tags with task executions. A DataSync task defines where and how data is transferred using AWS DataSync and a task execution is an individual run of a task. With this new feature, you can apply tags each time you execute a task, giving you greater control and management over your task executions. ...
